artBrief: **Sunny platformer.** A traveler passes through a giant open-book arch into a brighter landscape. A completed chapter, not an exam certificate or proficiency claim.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Sunny platformer. A traveler passes through a giant open-book arch into a brighter landscape. A completed chapter, not an exam certificate or proficiency claim. Use the white fox traveler stepping through the large open-book gateway. Make the open book the central dominant arch, with warm light beyond, grassy platformer landscape.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
